pages.quiz:
CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which note is played with the thumb hole and hole 1 covered? (1 mark)
   A. G
   B. A
   C. C
   D. B

2. The sol-fa syllable m is pronounced (1 mark)
   A. may
   B. mah
   C. me
   D. moh

3. A slab of clay is (1 mark)
   A. a flat piece
   B. a round ball
   C. a thin roll
   D. a hollow cup

4. In the hawk and the chicks game, the chicks (1 mark)
   A. sing
   B. hold on gently behind the hen
   C. hit the hawk
   D. run away

5. What joins the stems of a pair of quavers? (1 mark)
   A. A bar of soap
   B. A rest
   C. A rope
   D. A beam

6. Where should you place your hands in a crab balance? (1 mark)
   A. In your pockets
   B. Behind you, shoulder-width apart
   C. In front of your face
   D. On your head

7. If you finish a gymnastics session, what should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Push the mats
   B. Run around wildly
   C. Leave mats on the floor
   D. Put equipment away and cool down

8. How long does a crotchet rest last? (1 mark)
   A. One beat
   B. Half a beat
   C. No time
   D. Two beats

9. Supine means (1 mark)
   A. face up
   B. curled
   C. standing
   D. face down

10. What does the word indigenous mean? (1 mark)
   A. Brought from another continent
   B. Made in a factory
   C. Belonging to a people and place from long ago
   D. Very new

11. How should you clean the lens of a camera? (1 mark)
   A. With a stick
   B. With water and sand
   C. With your fingers
   D. With a soft, dry cloth

12. Which nationality was Zoltan Kodaly, whose method uses hand signs? (1 mark)
   A. Chinese
   B. Hungarian
   C. Brazilian
   D. Kenyan

13. A good sportsperson (1 mark)
   A. congratulates winners and encourages losers
   B. quits
   C. argues with the referee
   D. cheats

14. Why is it called the mushroom float? (1 mark)
   A. The back at the surface looks like the top of a mushroom
   B. It grows
   C. It is very tall
   D. It tastes good

15. Covering more finger holes makes the note (1 mark)
   A. silent
   B. lower
   C. louder always
   D. higher

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write the rhythm names of a pattern of a crotchet, a crotchet rest, a pair of quavers and a crotchet. (3 marks)

17. Explain what sportsmanship means and give two examples. (3 marks)

18. State four safety rules for the swimming pool. (4 marks)

19. Describe how to paint the Kenyan flag on paper. (5 marks)
pages.answers:
CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — B
   B uses the thumb and the first hole.

2. C — me
   The syllable m is me.

3. A — a flat piece
   A slab is a flat sheet of clay.

4. B — hold on gently behind the hen
   Chicks stay in line.

5. D — A beam
   A thick line called a beam joins them.

6. B — Behind you, shoulder-width apart
   Hands go behind you, about shoulder-width apart.

7. D — Put equipment away and cool down
   Tidying and cooling down are good habits.

8. A — One beat
   A crotchet rest is one beat of silence.

9. A — face up
   Supine is lying on the back.

10. C — Belonging to a people and place from long ago
   Indigenous instruments belong to a community and were made from local materials.

11. D — With a soft, dry cloth
   A soft cloth cleans without scratching.

12. B — Hungarian
   Zoltan Kodaly was a Hungarian music teacher.

13. A — congratulates winners and encourages losers
   Fair play and respect.

14. A — The back at the surface looks like the top of a mushroom
   The rounded back at the top looks like a mushroom cap.

15. B — lower
   More holes covered gives a longer air column, so a lower note.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: taa (rest) ta-te taa
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct part in order.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Being fair and kind in sports. Examples: following the rules and shaking hands with the other team.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for each example.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: Swim only when watched; never swim alone; walk on the pool side; no pushing; no diving in shallow water; follow the whistle. Any four.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

19. (5 marks)
   Answer: Cut a rectangle of paper in the ratio three to two. Draw the stripes and the thin white lines lightly with a ruler. Sketch the shield and the crossed spears in the middle. Paint black at the top, red in the middle and green at the bottom, leaving the white lines. Let it dry and attach it to a stick.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for the rectangle, drawing stripes, shield, colour order and drying with handle.
